These include the Mega Lotto 6/45, Grand Lotto 6/55, EZ2 (2D Lotto), Swertres (3D lotto), and 4D Lotto. item.title: RESULTS: 5,594 out of 11,425 pass 2025 Bar Exam
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — RESULTS ARE OUT! A total of 5,594 out of 11,420 (48.98%) have passed the 2025 Philippine Bar Examinations, reports said. Out of 13,193 registered applicants, 11,425 completed the three-day examinations held in 14 testing centers nationwide on September 7, 10, and 14, 2025.
